metadata.label: Note
metadata.value: Paper very browned and apparently burned at edges. Front cover munch reduced in size. Text perhaps incomplete. Fol. 35 missing. Undated, but an old MS. ; Twelve month calender with illustrations. Giving first general information about the place of the month in different calendars and then information regarding each day. ; Described in detail in: Catalogue of Oriental Manuscripts in Danish Collections, Vol. 3 [pp. 185-187]
